reason: A Windows desktop shell that embeds the local DeepSeek Harness web UI, manages its optional local service lifecycle, and adds native window controls with optional taskbar attention notifications.

summaries.zh: 将本地 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 封装进原生 Windows 窗口，并提供窗口控制、可选服务启动管理和任务栏提醒。
summaries.en: A native Windows shell for the local DeepSeek Harness web UI with window controls, optional service lifecycle management, and taskbar attention notifications.

capabilities: Wraps a local web UI in a native desktop window
Can start a configured local DSH service and stop services started by the shell
Provides single-instance window behavior and native window controls
Can poll a local attention endpoint and trigger Windows taskbar notifications
